messages.subject: Eigen unsupported include
parts:
To simplify the includes, I changed the code
in prob/autocovariance.hpp and prob/autocorrelation.hpp
to use

#include <unsupported/Eigen/FFT>

instead of just

#include <Eigen/FFT>

to save a -I argument to all the commands.

Daniel -- could you patch the makefiles? They
still work as is, of course.

- Bob
